--- title: OmicIDX description: SRA, GEO, BioSample, and BioProject metadata as Parquet files you can query from DuckDB, Python, or R. Rebuilt daily. No account, no key. toc: false --- [Get the data](guides/index.qmd){.btn .btn-primary .me-2 .mb-2} [Try it in your browser](playground.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary .me-2 .mb-2} [View on GitHub](https://github.com/seandavi/omicidx){.btn .btn-link .mb-2} ::: {.cell} ```{.sql .cell-code} -- DuckDB: no download, no credentials ATTACH 'https://omicidx.cancerdatasci.org/data/latest/omicidx.duckdb' AS omicidx (READ_ONLY); SELECT run_accession, study_title FROM omicidx.sradb.rnaseq_runs WHERE taxon_id = 9606 LIMIT 10; ```
Table: Displaying records 1 - 10 |run_accession |study_title | |:-------------|:--------------------------------------------------------| |DRR415303 |RNA sequencing of Epstein-Barr virus-infected cell lines | |DRR415304 |RNA sequencing of Epstein-Barr virus-infected cell lines | |DRR415305 |RNA sequencing of Epstein-Barr virus-infected cell lines | |DRR415306 |RNA sequencing of Epstein-Barr virus-infected cell lines | |DRR415307 |RNA sequencing of Epstein-Barr virus-infected cell lines | |DRR415308 |RNA sequencing of Epstein-Barr virus-infected cell lines | |DRR415309 |RNA sequencing of Epstein-Barr virus-infected cell lines | |DRR415310 |RNA sequencing of Epstein-Barr virus-infected cell lines | |DRR415311 |RNA sequencing of Epstein-Barr virus-infected cell lines | |DRR415312 |RNA sequencing of Epstein-Barr virus-infected cell lines |
::: ::: {.grid .mt-4} ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .p-3} #### Get the data {.mt-0} Everything lives under `https://omicidx.cancerdatasci.org/data/`. Query it in place with [DuckDB](guides/duckdb-snapshot.qmd), or use the [Python and R recipes](guides/index.qmd). [Releases](releases.qmd) lists every version, its tables and sizes. ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .p-3} #### Use it from R {.mt-0} The [omicidxr](guides/r-omicidxr.qmd) package connects in one line, pins a version, and replaces SRAdb and GEOmetadb. ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .p-3} #### Cite a release {.mt-0} Monthly releases on HuggingFace carry a git tag and a DOI. Download one and query it locally. See [Versions and citation](guides/versions-and-citation.qmd). ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .p-3} #### Try it in your browser {.mt-0} The [playground](playground.qmd) runs SQL against `latest/` with DuckDB-Wasm, and every SQL example in these docs opens in the DuckDB Shell. Nothing to install. ::: ::: New here? Read [what OmicIDX is](overview/what-is-omicidx.qmd), the [sources it indexes](overview/data-sources.qmd), and [how it's built](overview/architecture.qmd).
